svg.title: What did the blood test add to the diabetes history?

cc:Work.dc:title: What did the blood test add to the diabetes history?
cc:Work.dc:description: Two strips show measured glucose. Record 43 is just above 200 mg/dL in the no-history group; 11/87 in that group and 61/125 with diabetes history reached 200.

g.text: Glucose was missing in 26 of 113 without and 12 of 137 with diabetes history. Intervals use the Wilson method.
